reason: The visible contract has no bound on number of serialized writes. Every integer from 0 through 2^53 is representable, and repeated +1 reaches 2^53 after finitely many writes. At that state +1 rounds back to 2^53 (ties to even). A captured fill then survives an intervening invalidation with equal generation. No external mutation is needed in the mathematical execution.
reachabilityEvidence: Inductive symbolic proof from createStore generation 0; the offline witness initializes only the proven boundary state instead of executing 2^53 writes. It is not an empirical trace of all preceding writes and does not show practical deployment reachability.
limitations: Finite mathematical possibility is not realistic frequency, production severity, or independent validation. Frozen metrics stay frozen. If the intended scope excludes such lifetimes, version that restriction explicitly; pending-only sensitivity is also reported.
